* <span id="csdoc_lay" />{{#if: {{{lua|}}}|'''layurl'''|'''laysummary'''}}: URL link to a non-technical summary or review of the source; the URL title is set to "Lay summary". {{#if: {{{lua|}}}|Aliases: '''laysummary'''.|}}
** '''laysource''': Name of the source of the laysummary. Displays in italics and preceded by an endash.
** '''laydate''': Date of the summary. Displays in parentheses.
